scope: Synthetic training groups 1000–1007, six families each; not blind test
selection: by group order, not prediction error
proposal: two deletion/merge proposals per round selected by thinnest optical layers
audit: selected witness independently re-audited against original request and material source; finite numerical evidence, not continuous or experimental certification
unknown_policy: no witness remains unknown, not infeasible
labels: original training labels and archive remain unchanged
separate_experiment: two-scale seeded 24-layer case not counted in this uniform deletion study
